title_en: APARTMENT 2+1+2 FOR SALE AT ALI DEMI!
description_en: The apartment is located on the fifth residential floor, near Idriz Dollaku Street, at Evergreen Residence, one of the newest complexes in the area. The palace offers recreational, commercial spaces and underground parking. The apartment has a total area of ​​115.7 meters, net area of ​​100.4 meters and is organized in: A distribution corridor A living room together with the kitchen and access to the balcony A balcony in total Two bedrooms, one of which has an internal toilet and wardrobe Two toilets in total The favorable orientation from the east means that this apartment has natural lighting for most of the day. The property has a business contract and is registered as a mortgage.
